faq.question: Is the course really free?
faq.answer: Yes. All 6 modules, and your completion badge, are free. Official certification is a separate, optional path.

faq.question: What is the MTM survey and why do I need to complete it?
faq.answer: MTM (Metrics That Matter) is a short survey required by Microsoft before your free completion badge can be issued. This is a mandatory Microsoft requirement and applies to all learners.

faq.question: How do I get my free completion badge?
faq.answer: Finish all 6 modules, complete the MTM survey, and we’ll email you a redemption code to claim your badge on Microsoft Learn.

faq.question: What’s the difference between the free badge and official certification?
faq.answer: The free badge confirms you completed the course content. Official certification is a separate, verifiable credential that requires passing a proctored exam — it’s not available for purchase yet.

faq.question: Can I sign up for certification right now?
faq.answer: Not yet. Certification exam seats haven’t launched. You can register your interest, and we’ll reach out as soon as it’s available — no payment is required to register interest.

faq.question: Can I take this course on a Mac?
faq.answer: Yes, the course works on any device with a modern browser and a Microsoft 365 account.

faq.question: Do I need a Microsoft 365 Copilot license to take this course?
faq.answer: No, you do not need a Microsoft 365 Copilot license to take this course. You can access Copilot using your existing email ID.
